Form bhara gaya, par aapko khabar hi nahi hui? Customer ne aapki website par enquiry daali, aur do din tak kisi ne dekha hi nahi. 😬

Tab tak wo customer kisi aur se baat kar chuka tha. Aaj customer 3 4 jagah enquiry karta hai, aur kaam usi ko milta hai jo sabse pehle jawab de.

Isse kehte hain Silent Form. Ise theek karne ke 3 step:
1️⃣ Form chhota rakhiye: naam, phone, zaroorat. Bas.
2️⃣ Submit ke baad likhiye: hum aaj hi call karenge.
3️⃣ Har enquiry seedhe aapke WhatsApp par aaye, aur ek sheet mein save ho.

Aaj ka test: apni website ka form khud bhariye. Alert kitni der mein aaya? 5 minute se zyada laga, to aap customers kho rahe hain.

Save kar lijiye, aur us bande ko bhejiye jo aapki website sambhalta hai. 📩

Aapke paas enquiry ka alert kahan aata hai: email, WhatsApp, ya kahin nahi? Comment mein bataiye 👇
